record.question: India's first bank in India to deploy industrial robotic arms to count currency notes is;
record.explanation: Answer C: ICICI Bank. ICICI Bank’s own 2019 release says it was the first commercial bank in India to customize and deploy industrial robotic arms at currency chests. Option (c), index 2. Reference: https://www.icici.bank.in/about-us/news-room/2019/news-icici-bank-unveils-robotic-arms-to-power-note-sorting-at-its-currency-chests. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
